uv pulls in the rsa crate via reqsign-google for RSA-PKCS1v15 signing of Google service-account JWTs (used when fetching Python packages from a GCS-backed index). RSA decryption, the only code path susceptible to the Marvin Attack timing oracle, is never exercised.

GLIBC-SA-2026-0024 (CVE-2026-97399) is a one-byte overread in the Power8-specific strncasecmp optimization (BZ #34683). DHI pkg-glibc rebuilds target linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 only, so that Power8 implementation is not present in published glibc debs. See https://sourceware.org/git/?p=glibc.git;a=blob;f=advisories/GLIBC-SA-2026-0024

RUSTSEC-2026-0370 is an informational notice that zvariant is unmaintained as a standalone crate, not a specific security vulnerability. uv includes it transitively through secret-service and zbus 5.15 for Linux keyring support. No patched standalone release exists; remediation requires an upstream dependency migration to zbus 6 and remains under evaluation.

RUSTSEC-2026-0440 is an informational notice that astral-tokio-tar is unmaintained, not a specific security vulnerability. Astral ended maintenance of the crate on November 3, 2026, and all versions are deprecated; no patched release exists. In uv, the uv-extract crate uses it to extract tar archives. Upstream recommends tar-codec as a replacement; migrating uv to a different tar implementation is an upstream dependency change and remains under evaluation.
